spell.ebreduxaddon.cleanse.desc: Purges every harmful effect from the target, and keeps purging it for a while. Aim at nothing to cleanse yourself.
spell.ebreduxaddon.spine_volley.desc: Fires a fan of poisoned spines. Every fourth volley, the middle spine bursts into a lingering poison cloud.
spell.ebreduxaddon.grasp.desc: Seizes the first creature the beam touches and holds it in place while draining it. You cannot move while you hold on. Creatures brought low enough are finished off.
spell.ebreduxaddon.purifying_pulse.desc: Sends out a purifying wave from where you look. It heals allies, drives enemies back, burns fungal creatures and turns infested ground clean again.
item.ebreduxaddon.armor.last_stand: Full set (any Grafted or Sentient): Last Stand
